dependencyUpdates.description: Check for available dependency and Gradle updates

build.description: Build the project and run all tests

gradleWrapper.description: Update the Gradle wrapper to a given version

nativeTest.description: Re-run all Kotlin/Native tests from scratch

sdk_sources.description: Extract a *-sources.jar from the Gradle cache to /tmp/acp-sdk-sources for inspection (args: coordinate substring [version])

gitCommit.description: Create a semantic commit (e.g. "feat: add X"); never push

gitStatus.description: Show compact status with branch info (optional args: pathspec)

gitDiff.description: Show diff (optional args: e.g. HEAD, HEAD~1..HEAD, or pathspec)

gradleStop.description: Stop Gradle daemons and kill any lingering daemon processes holding cache locks
